grades.lower_bound_mechanism: lexicographic monovariant (sum of Ω, count of nonunits)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: gcd of p-adic valuations invariant via gcd(a,b-a)=gcd(a,b)
grades.notes: Complete, correct proof. Valuation move (min,|a-b|) and never-two-1s both proved. Termination via lexicographic (S,N): S drops when gcd>1, N drops when gcd=1; exactly-one-survivor argued both directions. Invariance handles zero and equal valuations; M formula explicit and finite.
